# mcp-datahub

> Composable MCP server for DataHub metadata catalogs. Read-only by default with twelve tools that surface search, schemas, lineage, glossary, and data products. Imports as a Go library to compose custom MCP servers with auth, tenant isolation, and audit logging.

mcp-datahub is a Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants safe, structured access to DataHub. Search across datasets, dashboards, pipelines, and queries. Read schemas, walk upstream and downstream lineage at table or column grain, fetch glossary terms, and resolve domains and data products. The standalone server works out of the box; the Go library lets you build custom MCP servers with middleware, interceptors, and transformers without forking.

## Key Capabilities

- Read-only by default. The three write tools require DATAHUB_WRITE_ENABLED=true and can be toggled per connection.
- Twelve MCP tools covering thirty-five operations through a discriminator pattern (what parameter on create/update/delete).
- Search across all entity types with keyword or semantic mode; advanced filters via fieldPaths, fieldTags, platform.
- Column-level lineage via datahub_get_lineage with level=column.
- Multi-server: configure several DataHub instances via DATAHUB_ADDITIONAL_SERVERS JSON, route per request.
- Composable Go library: middleware wraps tool execution; interceptors gate or rewrite requests; transformers redact or audit results.
- DataHub v1.3+ supported, full feature set on v1.4+, schema validated against v1.5.0.1.
- Stdio transport: ships as a standard MCP wire-protocol binary, no daemon, no HTTP server.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install
go install github.com/txn2/mcp-datahub/cmd/mcp-datahub@latest

# Wire to Claude Code
claude mcp add datahub \
  -e DATAHUB_URL=https://datahub.example.com/api/graphql \
  -e DATAHUB_TOKEN=$TOKEN \
  -- mcp-datahub
```
